_note: Allowed tag values for the swipe library. swipe_ingest.py tag refuses values not listed here. Add values here (with a one-line meaning) when a new pattern appears; never invent tags inline.

format.vs-stack: comparison stack, A vs B vs C, easy vs hard
format.problem-solution: problem line then solution line (formula in #969)
format.doctor-id-poster: static with the doctor's face and name/title as credibility
format.recruitment-poster: 'We are looking for 10 men who...' style
format.carousel: IG/LinkedIn slides or sliding vertical posters
format.doctor-explainer: doctor explains a topic, seated or standing
format.research-paper-overlay: doctor plus a paper/journal with highlight
format.doctor-pip-broll: small doctor bottom corner over full-screen b-roll
format.quiz-funnel: quiz as the ad's call to action or funnel
format.b2b: partner, dealer, investor, HR or franchise recruitment

hook.big-technical-word: opens with a technical term T20 viewers respect
hook.public-figure: names a figure the audience admires
hook.call-out: calls out a group: smokers, vape, 50+, CEOs, wives
hook.question: direct question to the viewer
hook.screenshot-open: opens on a chat or screenshot
hook.fast-forward: fast-forward scenes that show the place or process

market.kb-hardsell: Kota Bharu / East Coast: text-heavy, direct, BM
market.sj-t20-en: Subang Jaya / T20: English, premium, privacy, clarity
market.wives: speaks to the wife as decision maker

policy_risk.fake-doctor: actor or AI posing as a doctor
policy_risk.testimonial-clinic: patient testimonial for a clinic service
policy_risk.explicit: sexual or crude visuals or wording
policy_risk.deceptive: prank, fake story, counterfeit trick, fake scarcity
policy_risk.doctor-endorses-product: doctor endorsing a product (MMC Guideline V2/2025 5.14)
